title: Stratification analysis of a electrified biotrickling filter treating ammonium and nitrate-containing synthetic aquaponics wastewater
description: Development and stratification analysis of a tubular electrified biotrickling filter for simultaneous removal of ammonium and nitrate from aquaponics wastewater. The inoculum was derived from similar electrified biotrickling filters operated at the Laboratory of Chemical and Environmental Engineering (LEQUIA, University of Girona) and contained effluent from different reactors performing nitrification, denitrification, anammox, and activated sludge from the urban wastewater treatment plant of Quart (N.E. Catalonia, Spain) (see doi: 10.1016/j.biortech.2020.124221).
